title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Case Review: Deferral History
content:
**Case review guide — deferral history.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing hardship request for an account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the lower of the per-request cap and the lifetime room is adjusted, one month at a time, for the deferral history: an account that has never had a deferral adds the first-request month of 1; an account granted a deferral in the twenty-four months before the request loses the recent-deferral month of 1; any other account is not adjusted. The adjustment is added to that lower figure; the offer is never more than the lifetime room and never below zero.

## Reading the history

The history is the hardship deferrals booked on the financing account, each dated the day it was granted. "Granted in the twenty-four months before the request" looks at the most recent deferral's grant date.

| Deferral history on the account | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| No deferral ever booked | Plus 1 month |
| Most recent deferral granted within the 24 months before the request | Less 1 month |
| Most recent deferral granted 24 months or more before the request | None |

## Hypothetical cases

| History | Lower figure | Lifetime room | Offer |
|---|---|---|---|
| First hardship request | 1 | 6 | 2 |
| First hardship request | 2 | 2 | 2 (never more than the lifetime room) |
| Most recent deferral granted 10 months ago | 2 | 5 | 1 |
| Most recent deferral granted 30 months ago | 2 | 5 | 2 |
| Most recent deferral granted 5 months ago | 0 | 2 | 0 (never below zero) |
